source_readings.statement: European heat health warning systems are being deployed despite inadequate evidence verifying the effectiveness of specific heatwave interventions in reducing mortality or morbidity.
source_readings.scope: Populations and public health systems in Europe; unspecified publication timeframe.
source_readings.caveat: Does not provide measured morbidity or mortality reduction outcomes from any evaluated European heat health warning system.

source_readings.statement: Urban flood risk and reported severity in Uganda vary by geography and hydrology, with rapid-onset floods presenting elevated risk ratios over slow-onset events.
source_readings.scope: 939 surveyed households, local leaders, and focus groups in Greater Kampala Metropolitan Area (GKMA) and Kasese, Uganda.
source_readings.caveat: Cross-sectional survey and focus-group data; does not measure long-term health outcomes or test causal impacts of municipal flood adaptation measures.

source_readings.statement: An integrated MnO₂-catalyzed hydrothermal regeneration strategy restores degraded LiFePO₄ cathode materials to a Li/Fe molar ratio of 0.98 and 142.3 mAh·g⁻¹ discharge capacity at 0.2 C.
source_readings.scope: Laboratory-scale material regeneration experiment on spent LiFePO₄ batteries.
source_readings.caveat: Does not evaluate industrial-scale implementation, commercial plant economics, lifecycle emissions, or occupational exposures.

source_readings.statement: The WHO M-POHL network conducted the HLS19 comparative survey across 17 European countries between 2019 and 2021 to measure population and digital health literacy.
source_readings.scope: 17 European member countries participating in the M-POHL network between 2019 and 2021.
source_readings.caveat: Webpage excerpt describes survey execution and organizational intent; it does not present empirical survey findings, intervention outcomes, or health status improvements.

source_readings.statement: Indoor non-viable and viable microbial bioaerosols trigger respiratory inflammatory markers and immune responses, though the evidence base remains limited by observational and cross-sectional designs.
source_readings.scope: Synthesized global studies (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science) published between 2000 and February 2026.
source_readings.caveat: Narrative review of heterogeneous observational literature; cannot demonstrate clinical causation or establish definitive exposure thresholds across populations.

source_readings.statement: Recurrent flooding between 2022 and 2025 affected over 26 million people in Pakistan, compounding health system strain and accelerating infectious disease outbreaks and undernutrition.
source_readings.scope: Flood-affected populations, displaced communities, and health systems in Pakistan from 2022 to 2025.
source_readings.caveat: Bibliographic perspective/commentary abstract; does not provide primary epidemiological incidence data or systematic evaluations of health sector interventions.

source_readings.statement: A techno-economic model estimates that electric vehicle lithium-ion battery recycling profitability ranges from -$21.43 to +$21.91 per kWh depending on logistics, wages, pack design, and cathode chemistry.
source_readings.scope: Global techno-economic simulation model comparing commercial EV battery packs (e.g., Tesla Model S).
source_readings.caveat: Theoretical techno-economic simulation; does not report actual empirical profit-and-loss accounting or audited operational yields from operating commercial facilities.

source_readings.statement: Settled dust and indoor air in Vietnamese informal e-waste recycling sites contain elevated levels of brominated flame retardants and PCBs, with dust ingestion driving 60% to 88% of estimated daily PBDE intake.
source_readings.scope: Informal e-waste recycling workshop sites and one urban reference site in Vietnam.
source_readings.caveat: Quantifies environmental concentrations and modeled non-dietary intake estimates; does not assess clinical biomarkers or long-term health endpoints in exposed workers.

source_readings.statement: A scoping review of 45 studies on platform-mediated gig work found reports of physical and mental health risks, but concluded the literature is constrained by cross-sectional designs and a lack of causal evidence.
source_readings.scope: 45 peer-reviewed studies published internationally between January 1, 2000, and May 29, 2024.
source_readings.caveat: Identifies associations only; cannot establish causal relationships between digital platform labor dynamics and worker health outcomes.

clusters.name: Climate Extreme Vulnerability and Health System Strain
clusters.question: How do extreme climate hazards translate into acute population vulnerabilities and health system operational deficits?

clusters.name: Indoor and Occupational Environmental Contaminant Exposures
clusters.question: What are the non-dietary, inhalation, and bioaerosol pathways through which micro-environmental exposures induce biological risk?

clusters.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling Technologies and Techno-Economics
clusters.question: What chemical processes and logistical factors determine the technical regenerability and economic viability of spent lithium-ion battery recycling?

clusters.name: Health Policy Infrastructure and Digital Work Vulnerabilities
clusters.question: How do structural, institutional, and platform arrangements shape health literacy and occupational health outcomes?

links.reason: Both document that recurrent flooding causes severe infrastructure damage, displacement, and elevated injury or infectious disease risks in urbanizing Global South populations.
Both identify multi-sectoral institutional coordination and early warning integration as critical weak points in preparing health systems for climate shocks.

The economic model highlights that profitability depends strongly on recycling method and cathode chemistry (e.g., high revenue for cobalt in Tesla Model S), whereas EPMC-1d4b60c85f48 develops a low-cost regeneration process targeting cobalt-free LiFePO₄ cathodes.
Both demonstrate that non-dietary micro-environmental exposure routes (indoor air inhalation and settled dust) constitute significant exposure pathways to biological and chemical stressors.
Both reviews highlight that the respective evidence bases are constrained by a predominance of observational/cross-sectional data and lack longitudinal or causal designs.

unknowns.question: Do heat health warning systems (HHWS) in European municipalities produce measurable reductions in all-cause excess mortality during prolonged extreme heat episodes?
Does the hydrothermally regenerated LiFePO₄ cathode material retain cycling stability and cost advantages when scaled up from laboratory batches to industrial recycling lines?
What are the measured clinical biomarkers of organ toxicity or neuroendocrine disruption in informal e-waste workers exposed to high levels of BFRs and PCBs via dust ingestion?
What prospective, longitudinal health outcomes differentiate platform gig workers from comparable non-gig workers after controlling for baseline socio-demographic confounders?

note: No predefined module/topic labels, no fact verification or independent adjudication.
